entities.name: Graph RAG
entities.description: A method utilizing community summaries (C0-C3) and text chunks (TS) for question answering.
entities.evidence: All Graph RAG conditions outperformed na¨ıve RAG on comprehensiveness and diversity.

entities.name: na¨ıve RAG
entities.description: A baseline method used for comparison against Graph RAG.
entities.evidence: All Graph RAG conditions outperformed na¨ıve RAG on comprehensiveness and diversity.

entities.name: vector RAG
entities.description: A comparison method against which Graph RAG retains advantages in comprehensiveness and diversity.
entities.evidence: retaining advantages in comprehensiveness (72% win rate) and diversity (62% win rate) over vector RAG.

entities.name: Podcast dataset
entities.description: A dataset used to evaluate Graph RAG conditions, showing improvements in comprehensiveness and diversity.
entities.evidence: Intermediate-level summaries in the Podcast dataset and low-level community summaries in the News dataset achieved comprehensiveness win rates of 57% (p<.001) and 64% (p<.001), respectively.

entities.name: News dataset
entities.description: A dataset used to evaluate Graph RAG conditions, showing improvements in comprehensiveness and diversity.
entities.evidence: Intermediate-level summaries in the Podcast dataset and low-level community summaries in the News dataset achieved comprehensiveness win rates of 57% (p<.001) and 64% (p<.001), respectively.

entities.name: C0
entities.description: Root-level community summaries requiring dramatically fewer tokens per query.
entities.evidence: Root-level community summaries (C0) require dramatically fewer tokens per query (9x-43x).

entities.name: C3
entities.description: Low-level community summaries requiring fewer context tokens compared to source text summarization.
entities.evidence: for low-level community summaries (C3), GraphRAG required 26-33% fewer context tokens

entities.name: TS
entities.description: Global text summarization without a graph index, serving as a baseline condition.
entities.evidence: Conditions C1-C3 also showed slight improvements in answer comprehensiveness and diversity over TS (global text summarization without a graph index).

entities.name: Comprehensiveness
entities.description: A metric used to evaluate the quality of answers across different conditions.
entities.evidence: All Graph RAG conditions outperformed na¨ıve RAG on comprehensiveness and diversity.

entities.name: Diversity
entities.description: A metric used to evaluate the quality of answers across different conditions.
entities.evidence: All Graph RAG conditions outperformed na¨ıve RAG on comprehensiveness and diversity.

entities.name: sensemaking activity
entities.description: The type of iterative question answering characterized by the use of root-level GraphRAG.
entities.evidence: root-level GraphRAG offers a highly efficient method for the iterative question answering that characterizes sensemaking activity

entities.name: community summaries
entities.description: Summaries generated at different levels (C0-C3) used within the Graph RAG method.
entities.evidence: Community summaries vs. source texts. When comparing community summaries to source texts using GraphRAG, community summaries generally provided a small but consistent improvement in answer comprehensiveness and diversity, except for root-level summaries.
